parent_experiment.name: v4_paired_image_report_rag
parent_experiment.reason_for_revision: The generic BiomedCLIP image branch produced development MRR 0.016839 and fusion selected text weight 1.0.

research_scope: Chest-X-ray-specific paired image-report retrieval plus report-grounded question answering

input_protocol.candidate_pool: Union of the 600 development and 120 confirmation cases
input_protocol.view_policy: Encode each available projection independently as current_image with previous_image=None, mean normalized view embeddings per case, then L2-normalize
input_protocol.missing_image_policy: Exclude before encoding only if no declared image matches the verified official archive; report exclusions before outcomes

retrieval.tie_break: smallest absolute distance to 0.5, then smaller text weight

confirmation_gate.on_failure: Do not evaluate confirmation and report the development result as another negative finding

hypotheses: A chest-X-ray-specific joint encoder improves development image-to-report MRR over generic BiomedCLIP.
Paired BioViL-T RRF improves development and gated confirmation MRR over report-only BM25.
Improved paired retrieval increases deterministic top-1 report-grounded Token-F1.
claim_limits: The task evaluates matching images to existing paired reports, not diagnosis of new patients.
IU-Xray is the same source as prior report experiments, so this is a modality extension rather than external validation.
The model is used for research only and not for clinical deployment.
Automatic report-derived questions and metrics do not constitute radiologist validation.
